measurementMethod.scenarios: 22 sources x 2 strategies; 7 repeats above 10kB, 21 otherwise; equal initialization/warmups; order rotated; GC and external validation outside compile; completed map returned inside timed call
measurementMethod.corpus: 4155 distinct Lua; one paired sample per strategy; 7 known exhaustive traps checked separately
measurementMethod.focus: 21 deterministic time-quantile/high-overhead selections x 2 strategies; 3 repetitions, not corpus weighted
measurementMethod.distribution: R7 quantiles; ceil(n/10) samples for upper/lower tail means; medians per variant; no deletion of slower samples

selection.trigger: at least 3% observed slowdown in either mode among successful primary scenes

rejectedExperiments: Bulk JSON result bridge: previous measurements showed small map-off slowdowns; not adopted.
Temporary per-call scalar provenance hash indexes: local WASM draw probe showed mapped regression; reverted before final revision.
limitations: Ratios compare map ON to OFF in the same new implementation, not to the slower baseline.
Every map is completely generated inside the timed compile call; external revalidation and setup are outside.
One sample per full-corpus combination is broad coverage, not a per-input latency guarantee. The 21-source repeated focus is deliberately skewed and is not a population average.
Negative and very small timing changes are retained. Separate repeat checks are not replacements for primary observations.
Native validation is local Linux; hosted 3-OS CI was not executed.
Package version remains 0.3.0 in these identified development artifacts; v0.3.1 has not been published.

additionalExperiment.encodingView: Not adopted: complete maps matched but repeated WASM results did not establish a stable incremental speedup over fdf1707. Original final-map representation retained.
additionalExperiment.fusedEffectSeeding: Count root-reachable occurrences and tentative builtin aliases in one traversal; remove later-written roots before fixpoints; no input-spanning cache.
